content:
Sometimes, life’s just too fast for a normal person to actually “live”.  You’ve been making those plans and preparing for your big day, and when you’re actually getting closer, you feel like you’ve done nothing, or let’s put it this way, “others are doing better”. I know this happens to a lot of people, and I admit its happening to me now. It’s difficult to focus on what you must do, when all your focus is what’s going to happen if you don’t. In this world, I’ve learnt, it doesn’t work that way, nobody waits for nobody, you want something, you have to go get it, more often than not, you will be taking away someone else’s dream. That is a fact, and it’s the truth.

I’ll let Sir Shinoda explain what I’m going through right now, but as we all know it, In the End, it doesn’t even matter! ;)

Forfeit the game
Before somebody else
Takes you out of the frame
Puts your name to shame
Cover up your face
You can’t run the race
The pace is too fast
You just won’t last

– Courtesy – Mike Shinoda of Linkin Park
